_about: Generic FSK/GFSK burst decoder: channel filter -> FM discriminator -> clock recovery -> slicer -> sync-word correlator -> bit dumper (hex per burst). Works for most FSK packet radios: sensors, meters, pagers, 433/868/915 MHz ISM devices, BLE-like links.
use_when: a 2-FSK / GFSK burst signal (analyze_signal says FSK); set chan_freq, deviation, baud and the sync word / preamble

variables_help.chan_freq: absolute centre frequency of the signal in Hz
variables_help.chan_bw: channel filter width in Hz (~2 x deviation + baud)
variables_help.decim: decimation before demod (default keeps ~4 samples per symbol)
variables_help.access_code: sync word / preamble bits as a quoted string, e.g. '10101010101010101010' (alternating preamble) or the protocol's sync word
variables_help.nbits: bits to dump after each sync match

spec.name: fsk_burst_decoder
spec.title: FSK burst decoder
spec.description: xlating filter -> quadrature demod -> symbol sync -> slicer -> correlate access code -> burst bits
